persona.label: Operations Head (fleet-wide truth; no human natively sits in this module)
persona.frequency: checks fleet-wide device health multiple times daily; escalates when Snapshot/master-sync fails silently, since a stale or broken ingestion run is invisible until downstream symptoms (missing tickets, wrong uptime) surface

goals: Trust the data-as-of timestamp before making any fleet-wide call — never mistake stale ingestion for real fleet improvement
Know immediately when a Snapshot or master-sync run fails/sticks, instead of discovering it later via missing tickets or wrong Soft Inactive Count
See device departure/undeployment reconciled against open tickets — a device that left a plant must not keep generating phantom work or silently vanish from the queue
scopeNote: This module has no natural human operator — CONTEXT.md frames Snapshot/AutoPlant DB purely as backend ingestion, and the PRD refs given (194-198, 820-823, 781-819) sit inside device-detail/reporting chapters, not a dedicated ingestion chapter. Persona is therefore whoever is harmed when it fails silently: Operations Head (fleet-wide truth, Snapshot freshness banner) is primary; Zonal Manager is secondary (their queue silently empties/floods off stale or unreconciled device state). SPINE.md exists and was read (E-01, E-25) — both ingestion edges are marked PARTIAL/BROKEN with no reverse-reconciliation path, which anchors C3/C5 below.

capabilities.name: Snapshot freshness banner (data-as-of timestamp, every page)
capabilities.why: Without a trusted data-as-of stamp, Operations Head cannot tell a real fleet-health improvement from stale ingestion — CONTEXT.md explicitly warns this is the failure mode to avoid

capabilities.name: Snapshot run failure / stuck-run alert
capabilities.why: A FAILED or stuck (RUNNING-past-window) Snapshot means inactive devices don't surface in time for SE dispatch; if invisible, Operations Head's fleet uptime and Soft Inactive Count are silently wrong (O3 misleading metric)

capabilities.name: Device departure / master-sync reconciliation surfaced to a manager
capabilities.why: SPINE E-25: master-sync departure reconcile output is a file (stand-down-export.ts), no admin screen — a departed device's open tickets have no visible closure path for any manager (P3 no reconciliation)

capabilities.name: Integration health ledger (run history, not just latest status)
capabilities.why: Operations Head owns fleet-wide truth end to end; a single latest-status widget can't distinguish one bad run from a recurring pattern needing escalation (O1 no finished-work ledger)

capabilities.name: Soft Inactive Count shown as an auditable, explainable input
capabilities.why: CONTEXT.md: Soft Inactive Count silently flips the Recommender between deficit/preventive mode twice daily; SPINE E-01 shows the reverse path (device returns ACTIVE) does not close the resulting Ticket — Operations Head cannot explain fleet behavior without seeing this number's provenance and its known one-way gap
